Help-center excerpts:

[card-renewal] Card expiry and renewal (effective 2025-01-01)
We mail a new card automatically about 30 days before your current card expires. You don't need to ask for it.

## What changes

The renewed card has the same card number, a new expiry date and a new security code. Most merchants that store your card get the new expiry date automatically, but some don't, so check your subscriptions.

## What to do when it arrives

Activate the new card in the app. Your old card keeps working until you activate the new one or until it expires, whichever comes first.

## If it doesn't arrive

Check that your address in the

[card-renewal] Card expiry and renewal (effective 2025-01-01)
comes first.

## If it doesn't arrive

Check that your address in the app is current. If your old card expires and the new one still hasn't arrived, message support and we'll send another one at no cost.

## No renewal?

If your account is restricted or under review, we can't send a renewal card until that's resolved.

Questions? Our support team is available in the app at any hour.

[card-activate] Activating your card (effective 2025-01-01)
use it online or in a mobile wallet while you wait. It has its own number, so you don't need to update it when the physical card shows up.

## If activation fails

Check that you're activating the newest card. An old or replaced card can't be activated. If your card hasn't arrived within 10 business days of ordering it, message support so we can cancel it and send another one.

Replacement cards need activating too. For a damaged card, your old card keeps working until you activate the new one.

Questions? Our support team is available in the app at any

[card-damaged] Replacing a damaged card (effective 2025-01-01)
If your card is cracked, bent, or the chip or contactless stops working, order a replacement in the app.

## How to order

Tap Cards, choose the card, then Replace card, then Damaged. Confirm your address and pick a shipping speed.

## Your old card keeps working

When you report a card as damaged, we don't cancel it. You can keep using it (if it still works) until you activate the replacement. Activating the new card switches the old one off.

The new card has the same card number, a new expiry date and a new security

[disputes-subscriptions] Subscriptions that keep charging (effective 2026-01-15)
refund you, dispute each charge made after you cancelled. Tap the transaction, then Get help, then Cancelled but still charged. You have 120 days from each transaction date.

## Stopping future charges

If a merchant keeps charging after you cancel, you can report the card lost and get a new number. Recurring payments to the old number will then fail. There may be a replacement fee depending on your plan.

## Free trials

Charges after a free trial ended aren't unauthorized if you gave your card when signing up. Cancel with the merchant and ask for a refund.

[card-metal] The Premium metal card (effective 2025-01-01)
takes 2 to 3 business days.

## If you leave Premium

Your metal card keeps working until it expires. After that, or if you need a replacement, you'll get a plastic card.

## Disposal

Metal cards can't be cut with scissors. When you replace one, you can mail it back to us in the prepaid envelope that comes with the new card, and we'll recycle it.

Contactless works on metal cards the same way it does on plastic.

Questions? Our support team is available in the app at any hour.

[card-damaged] Replacing a damaged card (effective 2025-01-01)
new card has the same card number, a new expiry date and a new security code. Merchants that store your card may need the new expiry date.

## Cost and shipping

The replacement fee is the same as for a lost card: $5.00 on Basic and free on Plus and Premium. Standard shipping takes 7 to 10 business days. Expedited shipping takes 2 to 3 business days and costs $25.00 on Basic and Plus. It's free on Premium.

If you're not sure whether the card is damaged or lost, freeze it first. You can

We don't refund part of a month.

## Things to check before you downgrade

- If you use Cushion and move to Basic, Cushion switches off. Any negative balance still has to be repaid.
- Your Savings Pockets start earning the new plan's rate on the day the downgrade takes effect.
- A Premium metal card keeps working until it expires. Replacements after that are plastic.

Customer question:
When do you send a renewal card before mine expires? Do I get a new number?

Rules:

- Some excerpts are older versions of a policy. When two excerpts disagree, follow the one with the later effective date.
- If the question depends on the customer's plan (Basic, Plus or Premium), use that plan's numbers.
- If the question rests on something false (for example a fee that does not exist), say so and give the correct facts. That is an answer, not an abstention.
- Abstain when the excerpts do not contain the answer, when the question is not about Tallowbrook, or when it asks for investment, tax or legal advice. Set "abstain" to true and say briefly that the help center does not cover it.
